statement: Pinned xwiimote requires a kernel wiimote HID parent and reads evdev sibling interfaces. It does not issue MotionPlus memory transactions; opening MotionPlus triggers the kernel MP_USED path and receives ABS_RX/RY/RZ evdev data. A missing kernel MP node means xwiimote has no independent gyro decoder, and Nunchuk/Classic remain evdev sibling interfaces.

applicability.revision: TR/Gen 2 pinned consumer paths; no retail or firmware revision measured
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. xwiimote core.c 335-393,611-672,1045-1090; Linux MP module 2771-2782. All acceptance/physical experiments explicitly not run.
